ep4-absurdist-1.speaker: Sarah
ep4-absurdist-1.text: I've been milking a crow in here for days! This dry old crow!

ep4-absurdist-2.speaker: Prince Jam Roll
ep4-absurdist-2.text: Trudy, Trudy, Trudy, it's so nice to see you. But... you smell like shit, okay? So I'm gonna rip off my nose!

ep4-absurdist-3.speaker: Prince Jam Roll
ep4-absurdist-3.text: Monkey see, monkey do, Trudy! Monkey lie, monkey die, Jam Roll!

ep4-phil-1.speaker: Trudy
ep4-phil-1.text: Think of forgiveness as freeing your own heart... from these states of grudge and resentment and anger and ill-will.

ep4-phil-2.speaker: Clancy
ep4-phil-2.text: Forgiveness is the pull-up bar. We look at it... and we think, 'No... fucking... way.'

ep4-phil-3.speaker: Trudy
ep4-phil-3.text: Because if we really did understand that this body will be a corpse... we would have fewer of the kind of moments where we regret having wasted our time or somebody else's.

ep4-res-1.speaker: Clancy
ep4-res-1.text: This is your new home, Rose. No one's gonna bother you here. This is where you're gonna be safe. For the rest of your life.
